WildSpark 2.2.33 bundles its quest databases inside the single `WildSpark` addon folder. It embeds QuestDB v0.1.0 and QuestieDB Forever v1.1.1, so users only enable WildSpark.

WildInfo combines the existing QuestionableDrops quest-starter rows with QuestDropRates' static drop rates, QuestDB's creature drop rates, and QuestieDB's current quest/item relationships. Creature tooltips can now list known objective and starter drops for quests outside the player's quest log. Missing rates remain labeled as unknown.

QuestieDB's complete Forever database is used as the current quest/item source. The in-game index is built in timed batches after login to spread work across frames.
